title: A design consistency proof document
description: One evidence package's design consistency proof (SEG-SREQ-035). Self-contained: an auditor holding only this document can recompute the root from its own contents, without the graph that produced it (SEG-SYS-005) — sort the node manifest's hashes and the design edges' tuples, canonicalize snapshotId/scope/revision exactly as stated here, and fold them the way affirmatrix.commitment.design_root does. Evidence nodes and edges never appear: the design set is Requirements, TestSpecifications and Implementations, and the edges among them.

snapshotId.description: The scope's own minted identifier (SEG-SREQ-052), the one this package is sealed under.

scope.description: The requested requirement identifiers, sorted. Part of the canonical metadata the root is folded with.

revision.description: The current revision of the implementation repository this package was assembled against. Part of the canonical metadata the root is folded with.

id.description: The case-local stable identifier the node hash was derived from. Opaque case IRIs never appear in this document; an auditor recomputes from local identifiers alone.

kind.description: The design node kinds; TestOutcome and Waiver never appear here.

nodeManifest.description: Every in-scope design node's own hash (SEG-SREQ-037) — what the root recomputes from, together with designEdges and the canonical metadata.

designEdges.description: Every in-scope design edge, as the ⟨from, to, kind⟩ tuple the root folds.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest, lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters (ADR-0005).
